properties.accuracyNote: Approximate alignment traced from TJPA's map of the current (2026) design: 1.76 miles from the tunnel's west end to the east end of the train box, which includes the below-grade approach at the west end (U-wall and tunnel stub box), so it is longer than TJPA's '1.3-mile tunnel'; plus 0.39 miles of trackwork on existing tracks to 16th Street (2.15 miles in all; TJPA: 'total project length is 2.2 miles'). Georeferenced on 35 street intersections (DataSF centrelines), RMS 1.18 m; the map draws the line about 37 m wide, so the centreline is good to several metres. Stations are the centres of the station shapes in the map.

properties.check: Compared locally (not published) with the Authority's 'DTX (Downtown Extension)' line (1.32 mi, which predates the 2026 changes), sampled every 20 m. Its points lie median 7 m, 95th percentile 58 m, max 142 m from ours; ours lie median 20 m, 95th percentile 713 m, max 781 m from it (the far points are our approach south along Seventh Street, which its line doesn't include).
